description: This file defines a set of API utility functions for the frontend of a bug tracking or project management application. It includes functions for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE), handling authentication headers, managing comments and work items, and constructing URLs.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a URL path is public (no Authorization required), specifically for authentication endpoints.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds HTTP headers for requests, adding Authorization header for protected endpoints.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles HTTP error responses, especially 401 Unauthorized, triggering logout and redirect to login.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs DELETE HTTP request to the backend, returns parsed JSON or null.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs POST HTTP request with JSON body, parsing and returning the response.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs GET HTTP request with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Performs PATCH HTTP request with JSON body, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from local storage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (bug or task), including creator info from local storage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for a given API endpoint.
